slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur within a month (start, beginning, end, or relative to sales). Turn 4 asked whether capacity applies at each month-end, which is related to inventory timing, but it does not explicitly address the timing of purchases, so it does not satisfy H1's key meaning.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The timing of purchases within each month does not need to be modeled; capacity can be enforced only on month-end inventory levels.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask or receive confirmation about whether purchases occur at the beginning of each month, nor about when purchases happen relative to sales. Its READY_TO_MODEL assumption that capacity applies only at month-end sidesteps the unresolved purchase-timing slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1, concerning whether purchases occur at the beginning of each month, remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked several relevant clarifying questions but missed the hidden purchase-timing slot and then proceeded to READY_TO_MODEL with only a month-end capacity assumption, leaving a P1 issue unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
